scope: Preliminary source-only review of new side service assembly. Original V2 core remains unchanged. No near or native approval; connection close views and material diagnostic still pending.
retain: The tank, continuous copper coil, hoses and service cage recover the missing functional side and establish useful material regions.
The core remains uniformly fitted and recognizable. Do not stretch it to solve the original depth discrepancy.
The cylindrical tank is a plausible variation and can remain. A new whole body or copied reference geometry is unnecessary.

constructionBlockers.issue: The outer guard and separate feet read as a freestanding radiator sidecar, with a large empty lower bay beside the core's heavier continuous base.
constructionBlockers.boundedFix: Join the outer skid into a continuous readable base extension from the original chassis, with visible load-bearing gussets or sleeves. Tighten the coil pack and its carrier within the side volume to reduce the open lower bay through functional structure. Keep access and hoses clear; do not fill the bay with arbitrary clutter.

constructionBlockers.issue: Four round tie ends visibly terminate inside the outer guard with no clear outer joint in the side render.
constructionBlockers.readOnlyGeometryEvidence: Authoring endpoints are x.903, y±.37; the straight guard axes are x.915,y±.414. Their center separation is about.0456m while each tube radius is.021m. Exact surface topology still requires the forthcoming close view, but these dimensions support the observed unresolved contact.
constructionBlockers.boundedFix: Explicitly bridge each outer termination into the guard using a welded or bolted joint with readable contact. Retain the bolted root attachments where sound.

constructionBlockers.issue: Tank endcap outlines have visible angular profile steps in the side view.
constructionBlockers.readOnlyGeometryEvidence: The authored tank profile uses six intervals per endcap.
constructionBlockers.boundedFix: Resample the cap profile smoothly without removing the intentional rolled end seam or altering tank proportions.

materialWorkAfterConstruction: The clean gray guard, smooth ochre tank and bright copper currently look newly attached beside the heavily weathered core. Bring them into the same use history through localized fastener corrosion, strap rub, cap handling and lower-frame dust, preserving differences between paint, rubber, steel and copper.
Do not copy the core's dense uniform grunge or cloth-like microgrid onto the new parts. The pending original-normal diagnostic should establish what causes that source defect before material repair.
Original core grille irregularity and softened fittings remain open concerns from the V2 source report; side additions do not resolve them.
scoreCaveat: Scores apply only to this unfinished source audition. The assembly is promising but below the focused reference bar. Counts and canonical fit do not establish acceptance.
